items.title: Grouped resident expert submissions
items.status: implemented and reference-qualified; aggregate timing only
items.scope: Up to ten same-shape/count resident experts per existing Vulkan sequence; physical weight keys reused; host sums stay in routing order.

items.title: CPU/GPU expert overlap
items.status: implemented and reference-qualified; aggregate timing only
items.scope: Main thread submits/waits GPU work while existing CPU pool executes nonresident chunks. Worker failure and callback exceptions settle before returning.

items.title: Packed attention with resident epilogue
items.status: implemented and reference-qualified; aggregate timing only
items.scope: Packed Q4T relative attention can supply native sigmoid/projection/convolution/residual epilogue in one sequence under existing capability/observer/adapter guards.
